title: Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Billing Terms — Unpaid Fees, Suspension and Reinstatement
content:
A **Kestrel Care Rewards** Plus membership fee that is not collected leads, after a grace period, to suspension of the membership, and a suspended membership is either reinstated on payment within its window or closes.

## Terms

**B1 — Suspension.** A fee not collected for the level's grace period in days suspends the membership, at a level where an unpaid fee suspends the membership.

**B2 — Effect of suspension.** A suspended membership earns and redeems nothing.

**B3 — Reinstatement.** A suspended membership is reinstated only when the fee is collected no later than the date it was suspended plus the reinstatement window days, counted in calendar days with the suspension date as day 0; otherwise it closes. The suspension date is the date recorded on the membership when it was suspended, and the last day of the window still qualifies.

## Collection terms by level

| Level | Grace period after a failed fee (calendar days) | Unpaid fee suspends the membership | Reinstatement window (calendar days after the suspension date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | 0 | no | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 0 | no | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 0 | no | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 0 | no | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | 7 | yes | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | 14 | yes | 30 |

## Timeline (hypothetical dates)

| Suspension date (day 0) | Window | Last day the fee may be collected for reinstatement | Fee collected on that day | Fee not collected by that day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 January | 30 days | 19 February | reinstated | the membership closes |
| 5 October | 30 days | 4 November | reinstated | the membership closes |

## Points of judgement

- **Grace period.** A Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly fee that fails is left 7 days before the membership is suspended; a Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual fee, 14 days.
- **While suspended.** No points are earned and no Kestrel Cash is redeemed on the membership.
- **Fee collected on day 30 after the suspension date.** Day 30 is the last day of the window, so the membership is reinstated.
- **Fee collected on day 31 or later.** The window has passed; the membership is not reinstated and closes.
- **Free levels.** At Kestrel Care Rewards Member, Silver, Gold and Platinum suspension for an unpaid fee does not apply.
